QUOTE: "`LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` logs an error with the text length (not the text or llama's return code) and returns an empty `std::vector<int32_t>`. A null vocab also returns empty. 2. `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` ... passes the empty vector through. It also returns empty when no tokenizer is wired."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a failed tokenization yields an empty vector and that the backend also returns empty when no tokenizer is wired, and it draws the conclusion that the failure is indistinguishable from empty input.
